name: The Good Year
pitch: Sow twelve two-stone weeds in your guest and sit down: the live herb curve makes a 256-year weed stronger than any fruit in the game, and everyone from the Evader to the Wall is dead on the tenth second, unless they brought a cleanse.

new.name: Sown Field
new.effect: At t = 0 each plot you sow is a permanent tick on the enemy, c_tick 0.04 x the herb's potency. Closes: your basic attack, 1 % of linh lực per plot for the fight, and the plot, whose herb dies.

new.name: Surplus
new.effect: Tick damage the caps clip comes home as linh lực at half its amount, at most 5 % of maximum a pulse.
new.second_home: any tick build past the cap, such as The Second Sickness

new.name: Rich Soil
new.effect: +2 points to both tick caps while the target's linh lực is 50 % or more.
new.second_home: any tick build, against wards and deep pools

new.name: What They Had Left
new.effect: A cultivator you kill and plough in adds the years they had left to one plot.
new.second_home: any build that eats people, such as The Not-Yet-Full

new.name: Field plots
new.effect: +1 field_plots. The key exists, and the tree gives none today.

new.name: Scythe Day
new.effect: Qi hit, Wood, c_art 2.9, cost 0.12, 3 s, guarded on enemy health below 50 %.

new.name: Furrow Scripture
new.effect: Main, Thiên giai, Wood and Earth. herb_growth_pct 10, khi_huyet_pct 15, linh_luc_pct 20. Unlocks Sown Field and Scythe Day.

new.name: Furrow Line
new.effect: Theme spirit fields, Earth, outer, sealed by the Furrow Scripture, size 10. Notables Held Acres, Surplus, Rich Soil. Capability #14.

questions: Is the potency curve meant to do this? A 2-stone seed reaches full strength in 256 years and a 1,200-stone fruit needs 25,600, and Alchemy reads the same curve.
Should a cleanse clear a field? Here it does, and it decides the build.
